subject: Paper and Stan code for survival analysis with shrinkage priors

messages.author: a236d3d356ca53fd
messages.subject: Paper and Stan code for survival analysis with shrinkage priors
parts:
Our recent paper
 Peltola, Havulinna, Salomaa, Vehtari (2014). Hierarchical Bayesian Survival Analysis and Projective Covariate Selection in Cardiovascular Event Risk Prediction. In Proceedings of the Eleventh UAI Bayesian Modeling Applications Workshop, CEUR Workshop Proceedings, Vol-1218, 79-88. http://ceur-ws.org/Vol-1218/bmaw2014_paper_8.pdf
uses Stan for computation.

Stan codes for survival analysis with shrinkage priors (Gaussian, Laplace, and horseshoe) and Weibull observation model are available at 
http://becs.aalto.fi/en/research/bayes/diabcvd/

Aki
